entities.name: Juan Vicente de Güemes, 2nd Count of Revillagigedo
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Juan Vicente de Güemes Padilla Horcasitas y Aguayo, 2nd Count of Revillagigedo was a Spanish military officer and viceroy of New Spain from 17 October 1789 to 11 July 1794. In his role as colonial administrator, he is known as a reformer.
